title: postauthloginwithvalidcredentials
description: Test POST /auth/login with valid email and password to verify successful authentication returns 200 status with JWT access token, refresh token, and user payload.

title: getauthmewithvalidtoken
description: Test GET /auth/me with a valid Bearer token to verify it returns 200 status with the current authenticated user profile.

title: postauthswitchinstitutionwithvalidinstitutionid
description: Test POST /auth/switch-institution with a valid Bearer token and institutionId linked to the user to verify it returns 200 status with updated user context and active institution.

title: getinstitutionswithvalidfilters
description: Test GET /institutions with valid Bearer token and filters to verify it returns 200 status with a paginated list of institutions.

title: postinstitutionswithvaliddata
description: Test POST /institutions with valid Bearer token and required fields (name, CNPJ, email, phone) to verify it creates a new institution and returns 201 status with the institution record.

title: patchinstitutionswithvalididanddata
description: Test PATCH /institutions/:id with valid Bearer token and updated fields to verify it updates the institution and returns 200 status with the updated institution record.

title: getuserswithvalidfilters
description: Test GET /users with valid Bearer token and optional role or institution filters to verify it returns 200 status with a paginated list of users.

title: postuserswithvaliddata
description: Test POST /users with valid Bearer token and required fields (firstName, lastName, email, role, institutionId) to verify it creates a new user profile and returns 201 status.

title: getannouncementsactivewithauthorization
description: Test GET /announcements/active with valid Bearer token to verify it returns 200 status with active announcements visible to the current user.

title: posteventswithvaliddata
description: Test POST /events with valid Bearer token and required fields (title, type, startDate, academicYearId) to verify it creates a new institutional event and returns 201 status.
